ministries.name: Choir Department
ministries.description: Our ministry seeks to glorify God through songs that communicate the message of Christ and create an atmosphere of worship.

ministries.name: Youth Ministry
ministries.description: We are committed to raising a 360 degree youth who is balanced spiritually, emotionally, financially and socially through Biblical teachings.

ministries.name: Media Ministry
ministries.description: We are committed to capturing and sharing the activities, programs and special moments of the church through photography, videography, contents, livestreaming, graphics design and other digital platforms.

ministries.name: Administrative Department
ministries.description: We are responsible for coordinating and managing the administrative affairs of the church to ensure smooth and effective operations.

ministries.name: Ushers Ministry
ministries.description: We are dedicated to ensure orderliness, peaceful and comfortable worship experience for everyone who comes into God's presence.

ministries.name: Greeters Ministry
ministries.description: We are committed to ensure warm welcoming and friendly atmosphere for everyone who visits our church.

ministries.name: Children Ministry
ministries.description: We are committed to raising the children in a Godly manner, through Biblical teachings and guidance.

ministries.name: Men Ministry
ministries.description: We are committed to raise godly men and husbands, who are spiritually matured, responsible and grounded by the word of God.

ministries.name: Women Ministry
ministries.description: We are committed to raise a Godly, sound women, wife, and mothers who are purpose driven and committed to fulfill God's purpose for their lives.

ministries.name: Sunday School Ministry
ministries.description: We are committed to teaching, nurturing and equipping believers with a solid understanding of God's word.
